newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens says steel hit by low 96 prices.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens says steel hit by low 96 prices.

text.p: Hoogovens said on Thursday 1996 turnover volumes at its steel activities had edged ahead of the high 1995 levels, but that earnings had fallen due to lower sales prices.
Earnings from ordinary operations at its steel division fell to 427 million guilders in 1996 from a year-earlier 720 million.
"The fall was primarily due to lower selling prices for almost all products, although this varied from case to case," Hoogovens said in a statement.
But it said that an increase in demand for both steel and aluminium products was expected to result in higher prices during the course of 1997.
Earnings from ordinary operations at Hoogovens' aluminium activities plunged to 43 million guilders from a year-earlier 140 million.
"The sharp decline in metal prices up to and including October had a highly adverse effect on the smelter results," Hoogovens said.
Margins at the majority of processing operations were squeezed due to lower demand for rolled and extruded products.
The problem was exacerbated by an increase in European market capacity, Hoogovens added.
The steel and aluminium group earlier reported 1996 net profits fell to 326 million guilders from a year-earlier 507 million.
